se:constraints: At least one method of documenting and structuring functional requirements is used (CS2023 SE-Requirements topic 1a).
Record the selection rationale and scope for each chosen method or combination. CS2023 does not mandate using one uniform method throughout a requirement set.
se:options: A documented combination of use cases, user stories, or other context-appropriate structured methods
se:DM-REQ-FUNCTIONAL-DOC-METHOD.se:procedure: Compare candidate methods for their support of design and implementation and their specific strengths and weaknesses; choose at least one method, optionally using different methods for different requirements, and record the rationale. This is a curriculum-scoped decision aid, not a universal professional mandate.
se:DM-REQ-FUNCTIONAL-DOC-METHOD.se:scope_description: CS2023 SE-Requirements: Product Requirements KA Core 1a-1c; teaching scope only; no universal uniformity requirement or superior method inferred.

se:PAT-REQ-USER-STORY-SPECIFICATION.se:solution: When appropriate, use a short user story to document a functional requirement and preserve traceability. Other requirements may use use cases or another structured method; document the context-specific method choice without imposing global uniformity.
se:consequences: A stakeholder-readable and traceable requirement set may combine different context-appropriate methods.
The selected method supports design and implementation to varying degrees; no one method is universally preferred by the curriculum.
se:PAT-REQ-USER-STORY-SPECIFICATION.se:scope_description: CS2023 SE-Requirements KA Core topic 1 education scope; user stories are examples, not a requirement for one uniform format across a full requirement set.

se:CASE-09F-GH-DB-FAILOVER.se:outcome: GitHub reported database topology restoration at 16:24 UTC on 2018-10-22, followed by separate recovery of pending webhook/Pages backlogs by 23:03 UTC and green site status. Approximately 200,000 expired webhook payloads were dropped; completion of pending work does not imply lossless delivery. First-party incident report only, PENDING_REVIEW.

additions.se:locator: First-party GitHub Oct 21 2018 post-incident analysis: 2018-10-22 16:24 to 23:03 UTC timeline, including 16:45 backlog status and dropped TTL-expired webhook payloads.
additions.se:verified_content_summary: At 16:24 UTC replication/topology was restored while backlog remained; approximately 200,000 TTL-expired webhook payloads were dropped; by 23:03 UTC pending webhooks and Pages builds were processed and status green.

additions.se:statement: GitHub first-party report separates 16:24 UTC database topology recovery from 23:03 UTC completion of then-pending webhook and Pages build backlogs; approximately 200,000 TTL-expired webhook payloads were dropped.
additions.se:context: GitHub October 21-22 2018 MySQL replication/failover incident only.
additions.se:method: Publisher authored postmortem timeline source, bounded section read; raw HTML bytes not captured.
additions.se:result: Reported later backlog processing and green status, not guaranteed delivery of all attempted events.
additions.se:limitations: First-party self-report, no independent operational audit, no universal failure/failover guarantee.
additions.se:uncertainty: The publisher HTML raw-byte SHA256 and independent causal/loss audit remain UNKNOWN.
